paite: Bang i genta dia leh? Hehpihna a khan sem theihna dingin khelhna ah i om nilouh ding ua hia?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

paite: Om nilouh lou hial ding. Eite khelhna lama sisa, khelhna ah bangchin i hing thei lailai dia?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

paite: Eite Kris Jesu-a baptis luta om tengteng a sihna ah baptis lutin i om chih na theikei ua hia?
english: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

paite: Huaijiakin a sihna a baptis luta omin amah toh vuikhawmin i om uhi, huchia Pa thupinain misi laka kipana Kris a kaihthohtak banga eite leng hinna thaka i khosak theihna dingin.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism to death, that just like Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

paite: A sihna ki batpih a amah toh i kizop khit ngal un tuh, a thohnawnna kibatpihin leng i kizom sam ding hi.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

paite: I mihing lui a kiangah kilhdenin a om samta chih i thei; huchia khelhna pumpi hihmanthata a om theihna ding leh tua kipana khelhna sikhaa i om louhna dingin.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

paite: Kuapeuh sisa tuh, khelhna lakah a suakta ta ngala.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

paite: Huan, Kris kianga I suh sam tak aleh, a kiangah I hing sam ding chih I gingta ahi;
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

paite: Kris tuh misi laka kipan kaihthohin a oma, a si nawn kei ding chih i thei ngal ua; sihnain amah tungah thu a neita kei hi.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

paite: A sihna tuh khelhna lam thu ah khantawna din khat vei kia a si ahi, a hinna bel Pathian lam thu ah a hing ahi.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

paite: Huchi mahbangin nou leng khelhna lam thu ah sisain kisep unla, Pathian lam thu ah bel Kris Jesu ah hingin kisep un.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Huaijiakin, na pumpi uh duhgawlna thu mang dingin na pumpi si thei uah khelhna vaihawm sak kei un.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

paite: Na pumpi hiangte uh leng diklouhna vanzat dingin khelhna kiangah pe phal sam kei un; a hihhangin misi laka kipan hing nawn bangin Pathian kiangah kipia unla, na pumpi hiangte uh leng dikna vanzat dingin Pathian kiangah pe phal jaw un.
english: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

paite: Banghianghiam i chih leh, khelhnain na tunguah thu a nei takei ding, dan vaihawma om na hi kei ua, hehpihna vaihawma om na hi jaw uhi.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

paite: Bangchin ahi dia leh? Dan vaihawm a om i hih kei ua, hehpihna vaihawma om i hih jawk jiakin i khial ding uh ahi diam?
english: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

paite: Hilou hial ding. Kua kiang peuhah leng a thu mang dinga a sikha dia na lut un tuh sihna khopa khelhna sikha hiam, dikna khopa thu mang sikha hiam, a thu na man uh sikha na hi uh chih na theikei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that to whom you present yourselves as servants to obedience, his servants you are whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

paite: Ahihhangin, khelhna sikha nahita mahle uchin, thuginpi huaia na kipiakna uh, lungtang taktakin na juita ua, Pathian kiangah kipahthu om heh;
english: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto you were delivered.

paite: Khelhna laka kipan suahtak sakin nong om ua, dikna sikhate na honghita uhi.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

paite: Na sa uh hat louh jiakin mihing danin thu ka gen hi; na sa hiangte uh nitna kiang leh, tatlekna dinga tatlekna kianga sikha dia na piak phal bang un, tuin na sa hiangte uh sangthouna dingin dikna kiangah sikha dingin pe phal un.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

paite: Khelhna sikhate na hih lai un dikna lakah na siang ua.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

paite: Tua na thil zahpih sate uah, huai laiin gah bang ahia nanamuh jel uh?
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

paite: Huai thil tawpna jaw sihna a nahi nak ahi. Tunah bel khelhna laka hihsianga omin, Pathian sikhate na honghih un, siangthouna mu khopin na gah uh na nei uh a keihiam, huai tawpna khantawna hinna toh.Khelhna man tuh sihna ahi ngala Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Kris Jesu jiakin khantawna hinna ahi.
english: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

paite: Khelhna man tuh sihna ahi ngala Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Kris Jesu jiakin khantawna hinna ahi.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
